match_table.match: Cape Verde Islands vs Saudi Arabia

conservatism_flags: At least 75% of 2026 modal scores are 0-0, 1-0, 0-1 or 1-1.
Fewer than 10% of 2026 modal scores contain three or more goals.
Historical modal scores materially underrepresent 3+ goal outcomes.
Historical modal favorite margins are narrower than realized favorite margins.

spain_vs_cape_verde.matrix_explanation: The modal 1-0 is mathematically logical for independent low lambdas: it is the largest individual cell. It is footballistically cautious because Spain's aggregate favorite probability is much stronger than the modal margin suggests.

diagnosis.primary_evidence: Historical modal totals and favorite margins are compressed relative to actual outcomes.

causes.cause: A. Compression des ratings / Elo gap trop faible
causes.recommended_test: Compare rating gap with lambda gap by favorite bucket.

causes.cause: B. Lambdas attaque/défense trop proches de la moyenne
causes.evidence_for: Historical modal favorite margin trails actual by 0.604.
causes.evidence_against: Published lambda audit reports meaningful pairwise differences.

causes.cause: C. Cap implicite sur favorite xG
causes.evidence_for: Very few 3+ modal scores appear for strong favorites.
causes.evidence_against: V2.2 metadata reports no explicit lambda clipping.
causes.recommended_test: Inspect upper-tail favorite lambdas and clipping flags.

causes.cause: D. Trop forte probabilité de nul
causes.evidence_for: Low-score draw cells are frequently modal.
causes.evidence_against: A draw correction can damage calibrated 1X2.

causes.cause: E. Distribution Poisson trop concentrée sur petits scores
causes.evidence_for: Actual 3+ total rate is 49.1% versus 2.2% modal.
causes.evidence_against: A modal distribution is inherently narrower than realized scores.
causes.recommended_test: Total-goals temperature challenger with score-likelihood guardrail.

causes.cause: F. Calibration optimisée pour log loss 1X2 plutôt que score likelihood
causes.evidence_for: The hybrid objective can aggregate outcome cells without rewarding realistic modal margins.
causes.evidence_against: Poisson score likelihood remains indirectly represented.
causes.recommended_test: Use historical score log likelihood as a challenger criterion.

causes.cause: G. Manque de feature mismatch / mismatch boost
causes.evidence_for: Strong favorites lack an explicit post-model mismatch term.
causes.evidence_against: Ratings and attack/defence features already encode mismatch.
causes.recommended_test: Targeted mismatch boost benchmark, no full retrain.

causes.cause: H. Données historiques internationales trop prudentes
causes.evidence_for: International group and qualification games include cautious regimes.
causes.evidence_against: The same corpus also contains large mismatches.
causes.recommended_test: Segment totals and margins by competition tier.

causes.evidence_for: World Cup group-stage priors may suppress totals.
causes.evidence_against: The historical issue also appears across competitions.
causes.recommended_test: Compare group-stage and qualification matrix realism.

diagnosis.selection_rule: Historical test is the arbiter; World Cup 2026 is descriptive and cannot select a challenger.
